answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing: the house and every box install hooks with cairn test --reseal-install, so the new hook reaches a box only when that is re-run there, which is named in the READY. Also that git merge refuses over a staged index, measured 2026-11-16 (rc 2); a merge with --no-commit then git commit already runs pre-commit with MERGE_HEAD present.

The ticket carries all four.

That is the same index, which git guarantees holds only the merge. The guard's rule is untouched.

bullets.text: A pre-merge-commit hook cannot see MERGE_HEAD, so the artifact check's shared-index guard would refuse every land if run unchanged; the hook names the index the way a hand check does.
